chunks.l2:
[tal-a20-v01] Now I speak the initiation that brings confidence to the deluded.

[tal-a20-v10] By the conductless one no proof is declared in initiation — since knowledge is its own proof and deserves no further fruit.

[tal-a20-v02] In the triangle, the fire's seat, blazing all around with the fire-letter, fanned by the wind-abode — on the left hand, fiercely blazing.

[tal-a20-v03] Having taken a little seed — this very seed — likewise inside the heart and in the hand, being burned: let the true one, absorbed in its muttering, visualize it.

[tal-a20-v04] Oppressed by the burning of the fire-kindled unbroken phaṭ-series, the seed goes to seedlessness, unable to fruit itself.

[tal-a20-v05] Roasted, it is not for sprouting; yet by that very proof — the karmas called mala and māyā, by force of mantra, meditation, and rite —

[tal-a20-v06] burned up, not for their effect. But this seedlessness-proof the venerable, most gracious Śambhunātha demonstrated to me.

[tal-a20-v07] And of the seed too, the joining is to be done here, by the guru's grace — since initiation, by brilliance, liberates even the immobile.

[tal-a20-v08] The guru who, having known in himself mastery of muttering, fire-offering, worship, and meditation, performs initiation — his initiation is held to carry visible proof.

[tal-a20-v09] Not for the shaken-off, the conductless, the tattva-knower is this rule; by the conduct-bound is performed the initiation endowed with seen proof.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C20 atha śrītantrāloke viṃśatitamamāhnikam atha dīkṣāṃ bruve mūḍhajanāśvāsapradāyinīm trikoṇe vahnisadane vahnivarṇojjvale@bhitaḥ / vāyavyapuranirdhūte kare savye sujājvale bījaṃ kiṃcidgṛhītvaitattathaiva hṛdayāntare / kare ca dahyamānaṃ saccintayettajjapaikayuk vahnidīpitaphaṭkāradhoraṇīdāhapīḍitam / bījaṃ nirbījatāmeti svasūtikaraṇākṣamam taptaṃ naitatprarohāya tenaiva pratyayena tu / malamāyākhyakarmāṇi mantradhyānakriyābalāt dagdhāni na svakāryāya nirbījapratyayaṃ tvimam / sa śrīmānsuprasanno me śaṃbhunātho nyarūpayat bījasyāpyatra kāryā ca yojanā kṛpayā guroḥ / yato dīkṣā sudīptatvātsthāvarāṇyapi mocayet yo gururjapahomārcādhyānasiddhatvamātmani / jñātvā dīkṣāṃ carettasya dīkṣā sapratyayā smṛtā avadhūte nirācāre tattvajñe natvayaṃ vidhiḥ / sācāraiḥ kriyate dīkṣā yā dṛṣṭapratyayānvitā nirācāreṇa dīkṣāyāṃ pratyayastu na gadyate / jñānaṃ svapratyayaṃ yasmānna phalāntaramarhati

chunks.l2:
[tal-a20-v11] 'Through the fruit, meditation and the rest are to be effected' — thus the Siddhāmata teaches; or let him perform the balance-purity test, the proof-joining one.

[tal-a20-v12] As told in the venerable Tantrasadbhāva by the Supreme Lord — and in the venerable Pūrvaśāstra too this is indicated by the Supreme Lord.

[tal-a20-v13] Bliss, uprising, tremor, sleep, and whirling the fifth — thus says the teacher of śakti's gradation.

[tal-a20-v14] The uprising comes through lightness, from concealment of body-grasp; for the body is earthen and chief — then it abandons chiefness.

[tal-a20-v15] With the forthcoming-levitation mantra, having meditated the disciple floated up, let the guru perform there all the remaining rites as before stated.

[tal-a20-v16] Told is this very balance-purity initiation, the giver of proof.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-dhyānādi tu phalātsādhyamiti siddhāmatoditam / tulāśuddhiparīkṣāṃ vā kuryātpratyayayoginīm yathā śrītantrasadbhāve kathitā parameśinā / śrīpūrvaśāstre@pyeṣā ca sūcitā parameśinā ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nidrā ghūrṇiśca pañcamī / ityevaṃvadatā śaktitāratamyābhidhāyinā udbhavo laghubhāvena dehagrahatirohiteḥ / deho hi pārthivo mukhyastadā mukhyatvamujjhati bhāvilāghavamantreṇa śiṣyaṃ dhyātvā samutplutam / karmāṇi tatrāśeṣāṇi pūrvoktānyācaredguruḥ uktā seyaṃ tulāśuddhidīkṣā pratyayadāyinī / [AbhT_20.16]
